title: althaea racemosa
intro: Althaea racemosa, commonly known as marsh mallow, is a perennial plant species belonging to the mallow family (Malvaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including soothing digestive issues and relieving inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Althaea racemosa are attributed to its ability to form a protective barrier on the mucous membranes, reducing irritation and promoting healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
